visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Greeting says Hi with no name
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The method works when called as person.greet(), but when it is given to the button the name is missing. Inside the callback, this is no longer the object.

solution.explanation: When a method is passed as a callback, the browser calls it with this set to the element that got the event (the button), which has no name. bind(user) makes a copy of the function with this fixed to user.
